{{NPC Infobox |image=NPC Selene and Sura.png |type=Open-World |nation= |location=Septimont }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a female NPC traveling with '''"Sura"''' and can be found at the Septimont in {{Location|Titanbone Expanse}} docks custom counter during the morning arguing with '''Varinia'''.

It is unknown what "Sura" is, but she appears human. ==Location== NPC Selene and Sura Location.png {{Dialogue Start}} ==Idle== ;(Morning) :'''Varinia:''' Welcome to Septimont, may I see you and your compan... I mean, your passport please. :'''Selene:''' No, no, you were right. Here are two passports. ==Dialogue== ;(Morning) :'''Varinia''' The extra passport isn't required, but you do need to fill out a form for your doll. :'''Selene:''' Sura is my friend. Please register us as travel partners. :'''Varinia''' Your friend, eh? Well, please fill out a customs clearance form for your friend. :'''Selene:''' But I have two passports right here— :'''Varinia''' Fill out the form, please. ---- ;(Night) :'''Selene:''' Don't be sad, Sura. They may consider you an object, but in my heart, you'll always be my best friend. :'''"Sura":''' ...... :'''Selene:''' Mm-hmm, I know, I know. {{Dialogue End}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Selene |zhs = 塞琳 |zht = 塞琳 |ja = セリン |ko = 셀레네 |fr = Selene |de = Selene |es = Selene |th = เซลีน }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.4}}
